title: Claude Code v2.1.220 and v2.1.210-v2.1.219: Opus 5 default, 10 releases with major security, background agent, and accessibility improvements
description: Over 10 releases in the period, Claude Code integrated Claude Opus 5 as the new default Opus model (1M context, 128K output, fast mode at $10/$50 per million tokens). Other highlights include background /code-review as a subagent, /fork creating background sessions, nested subagents up to depth 3, emoji shortcode autocomplete, a new EndConversation tool for abusive users, sandbox.network.strictAllowlist, concurrent subagent caps, and major screen reader mode improvements. Critical fixes addressed a Windows path corruption bug (\\u to CJK), quadratic slowdown in long sessions, and a prompt-caching billing regression on Bedrock/Vertex.

community_feedback.quote: Claude Opus 5 delivers near Fable 5 intelligence at Opus speed and cost.
It's a strict upgrade over Opus 4.8, and the gains are biggest exactly where it matters: the harder, vaguer tasks.
It's the clearest jump in problem-solving we've seen from one Claude model to the next.
On FrontierCode 1.1, Claude Opus 5 approaches Fable-level performance at half the cost.

title: Claude Opus 5 released as new flagship model
description: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 with 1M token context window, 128K max output, and adaptive thinking with configurable effort parameter. Opus 5 more than doubled Opus 4.8's Frontier-Bench v0.1 score and achieved 3x the next-best model on ARC-AGI 3. Priced at $5/M input, $25/M output (same as Opus 4.8).

community_feedback.quote: It's the clearest jump in problem-solving we've seen from one Claude model to the next.
Claude Opus 5 delivers near Fable 5 intelligence at Opus speed and cost.

title: Claude Opus 5 added to GitHub Copilot model picker
description: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 was added to Copilot with strengths in autonomous code changes, regression verification, and multi-tool coordination. Available for Copilot Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise (admins must enable explicitly). Billed at provider API list price under usage-based billing across VS Code, Visual Studio, CLI, Cloud Agent, and more.

community_feedback.quote: Excitement around the rapid expansion of available models -- Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.6 Flash, GPT-5.6 variants all within the same month.
7x for Opus... what's the point of Copilot now?

title: Devin release notes (July 24): Redesigned model picker, slash commands, OIDC tokens, Windows sessions from Slack
description: Devin shipped a redesigned unified model picker (capability/Fusion/speed/mode in one place), discoverable slash commands in the message box (/btw, /queue, /ask), playbook previews on hover, the ability to start Windows sessions from Slack via !windows, approve/deny network access from Slack, clickable finding counts in Devin Review, required approvals visibility, OIDC identity tokens for cloud auth, and API additions for unarchiving sessions and creating ingestion-mode code scans.

title: 13 legacy model snapshots retired including gpt-5-codex and gpt-5.1-codex variants
description: OpenAI shut down 13 model snapshots on July 23, including gpt-5-codex, gpt-5.1-codex, gpt-5.1-codex-max, gpt-5.1-codex-mini, and gpt-5.2-codex. Users must migrate to GPT-5.5 or GPT-5.6 family (Sol/Terra/Luna). The next retirement wave is scheduled for October 23, 2026.

community_feedback.quote: Some users report needing to migrate quickly from retired codex models to GPT-5.6 variants.

title: ChatGPT desktop app v26.715: Voice mode, multi-folder local projects
description: ChatGPT desktop app update introducing Voice mode (powered by GPT-Live) to talk through work and coordinate tasks across Chat, Work, and Codex, with macOS Screen context sharing. Also adds multi-folder local project support with a designated primary folder driving new chats, Git operations, and auto-discovery of AGENTS.md and skills.

title: Copilot Cloud Agent for Linear reaches GA
description: GitHub announced GA of the Copilot cloud agent for Linear, letting teams assign Linear issues directly to Copilot's async cloud agent. The agent works in an ephemeral environment powered by GitHub Actions, streams progress to the Linear timeline, and opens draft PRs. New GA controls include model selection, custom agent support, branch control, and mid-session steering via comments.

community_feedback.quote: The Copilot cloud agent for Linear was well-received as a natural workflow integration.

title: Agent Automation Controls in GitHub Issues (Public Preview)
description: GitHub introduced new controls for agent automations that label, type, assign, and close issues in GitHub Issues. The controls add approval workflows, confidence indicators, and rationale for agent actions.

title: Devin release notes (July 22): Devin Outposts, Linear thread handling, automations consumption visibility
description: Devin introduced Outposts for running workloads in your own environment, smarter Linear thread handling (replies route to the correct session), a new Consumption tab showing ACUs used by each automation, Slack channel improvements for automations, safer MCP access changes with warning steps, and performance improvements including faster webapp loading and better large diff handling.

title: Gemini CLI v0.52.0: Caretaker services, robust file editing, plan mode improvements
description: Stable release introducing a new caretaker triage worker with Cloud Run webhook ingestion and egress services, bypassing LLM corrections for JSON/IPYNB file edits to ensure accuracy, simplified plan mode write policies for relative paths, and improved account visibility messages for users without a Code Assist tier.

community_feedback.quote: Gemini CLI is updating so fast! The team pushes multiple releases per day.
Is it just me or is the Gemini CLI team going absolutely nuts -- positive reaction to the pace of updates.
Genuine question -- how is Gemini CLI still so far behind compared to Claude Code and Codex CLI?

title: Gemini CLI v0.53.0-preview.0: Caretaker LLM triage orchestrator, sandbox hardening, A2A RCE prevention
description: Preview release adding a Caretaker LLM triage orchestrator for automated issue/PR triage, macOS Seatbelt profile alignment with deny-default model, workspace trust and task isolation to prevent A2A Remote Code Execution, infinite ReAct loop mitigation, and credential verification fixes.

title: Cursor Router: intelligent model routing for Auto mode
description: Cursor launched Router, an intelligent model router that classifies each coding request by task type, complexity, and domain, then routes it to the optimal model. It offers three modes (Intelligence, Balance, Cost) and in A/B tests across millions of requests delivered frontier-quality performance at 60% savings. Trained on over 600,000 live requests. Available for Teams and Enterprise plans only.

community_feedback.quote: Auto previously meant a predictable flat rate. After the update, Auto migrated to Auto Balance, which started billing at frontier model rates without clear notification.
Individual plan users frustrated that Router is Teams/Enterprise-only with no clear prior communication.
Model-blocking controls are Enterprise-only, while Teams users can only see which model was selected but cannot restrict the model pool.
Praise for engineering quality and excitement about potential cost savings.

title: Codex CLI v0.145.0: Multi-Agent V2, Bedrock support, audio inputs, cross-tool import
description: Major Codex CLI release featuring paginated thread history, expanded /import (now migrates settings from Cursor and Claude Code including MCP servers and sessions), experimental Amazon Bedrock support with GPT-5.6 Sol as default, audio inputs with realtime V3 conversations, and stabilized Multi-Agent V2 with sub-agents supporting independent model selection and sandbox profiles. Also shipped 6 stable patches and 10 alpha pre-releases in the period.

community_feedback.quote: Not easily impressed, but holy wow -- the recent Codex improvements are remarkable.
The /import feature from Cursor and Claude Code is seen as a significant switching-cost reducer.
Multi-agent V2's ability to parallelize across model tiers is highlighted as a standout feature.
Giving the CLI full autonomy causes it to rewrite so much that I lose track of everything.
After GPT-5.6 rollout, Codex could no longer spawn subagents with specific models or reasoning effort.

title: Introducing Devin Outposts: Run Devin Cloud sessions on any machine you operate
description: Cognition announced Devin Outposts, enabling Devin Cloud sessions to run on any user-operated machine -- GPU boxes, VMs in private networks, Kubernetes clusters, or local hardware. Outposts are named queues with workers that only dial out (no inbound connectivity required). Partners include Namespace (Apple M5 macOS), Cloudflare, Modal, NVIDIA Brev, Daytona, and E2B. A reference Kubernetes implementation is provided.

community_feedback.quote: Partner endorsements from Namespace, Cloudflare, Modal, NVIDIA, Daytona, and E2B.
89% of all code committed at Cognition is now written by Devin, up from 13% in December 2025.

title: Gemini 3.6 Flash added to GitHub Copilot
description: Google's Gemini 3.6 Flash was added to Copilot, designed for web/app development, coding, and longer-horizon agentic tasks. This follows the announced deprecation of Gemini 2.5 Pro and Gemini 3 Flash.

community_feedback.quote: Reddit discussion on r/GithubCopilot about Gemini 3.6 Flash being now generally available.

title: Agent Swarms blog: AI agents autonomously rebuild SQLite from spec
description: Cursor published a research blog documenting a swarm of AI agents autonomously rebuilding SQLite from its 835-page specification into a Rust replica that passed 100% of a held-out test suite. The hierarchical architecture reached ~1,000 commits/hour and reduced costs ~8x from ~$10,565 to ~$1,339 per run. Generated significant HN and Reddit discussion.

community_feedback.quote: Generated significant discussion on Hacker News and Reddit, with excitement about scalability implications and debate about agent swarm economics.

title: Devin Desktop v3.5.17: Cloud session performance, Fast Context, hooks migration
description: The latest Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf) release brings faster rendering for long cloud sessions, inline network policy configuration, Fast Context support in Devin Local, a hooks tab in Devin Local Customizations, instant worktree-backed sessions, and a command to migrate Windsurf hooks into Devin hooks. Status bar is now hidden by default in the Agent Command Center.

community_feedback.quote: RIP Windsurf -- Devin is the most cringy thing I've seen in the last 10 years.
Users question whether development has stalled post-acquisition by Cognition.

title: Devin release notes (July 17): Centralized plugin management, multi-repo code scans, chained attack paths
description: Major Devin update introducing centralized skill management via plugins (installable and governable across Cloud, CLI, and Desktop), enterprise-grade plugin governance, multi-repository code scans with per-repo details, chained attack paths linking related security findings, a new Tasks tab, inline link previews, sortable chat tables, revamped automations pages with GitHub Enterprise Server support, and instant Slack unsync command.

title: Cursor in Slack improvements: multi-repo, cross-channel workflows
description: Cursor upgraded its Slack integration with plan-first behavior (sharing a plan before starting work), multi-repo environment support, cross-channel workflows (reading from and posting to other channels), and UI refinements including compact footers and cleaner rendering of tables and PRs.

community_feedback.quote: Multi-repo and cross-channel support well-received.

title: Gemini CLI v0.51.0: Security hardening, caretaker Cloud Run services, thought leakage fix
description: Stable release implementing Cloud Run webhook ingestion service, three major security fixes (case-insensitive sensitive path blocklist, symbolic link directory escape resolution, read-only ~/.gitconfig in macOS sandbox), stripping thoughts from scrubbed history turns to prevent model thought leakage, and escape sequence preservation for modern models.

community_feedback.quote: The absolutely insane pace of updates, with new features dropping every other day.

title: Continue: All cloud user data permanently deleted as product wind-down completes
description: Following Continue's acquisition by Cursor (Anysphere) in mid-June 2026, all remaining cloud user data was permanently deleted on July 15, 2026. The GitHub repository has been marked read-only and is no longer actively maintained. The final release was v2.0.0-vscode (June 19, 2026) with telemetry removed and authentication code stripped. The codebase remains available under Apache 2.0.

community_feedback.quote: There was no press release, no migration wizard, and no warning beyond a homepage FAQ.
Cursor acquires Continue right after SpaceX acquires Cursor. Consolidation is rapidly increasing.

title: Visual Studio June Update: Copilot usage tracking, MCP trust validation, C++ modernization agent GA
description: Major Visual Studio 2026 update adding real-time Copilot usage tracking with limit notifications, trust validation for MCP servers comparing against a trusted baseline, GA of the C++ Modernization Agent (MSVC upgrade scenarios), long-distance next edit suggestions spanning entire files, and in-IDE pull request review.

title: Agentic Autofix for Code Scanning Alerts (Public Preview)
description: A fully agentic version of Autofix that autonomously creates fixes for CodeQL-generated code scanning alerts. Supports multi-file remediation, creates review-ready workflows, and can auto-generate PRs with verified fixes. Powered by the Copilot cloud agent.
